data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for dynamic control of Android window modes and WindowManager LayoutParams.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter developers to dynamically manipulate Android window flags, such as disabling screenshots using FLAG_SECURE or keeping the screen on, on a per-screen basis. It automatically tracks applied flags and re-applies them when Android recreates the Activity.
use_when: You need to disable screenshots or screen recording for specific screens on Android.
You need to dynamically adjust window flags like FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON from within your Flutter code.
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS or other non-Android platforms, as the package only supports Android.
You require cross-platform window management or secure screen solutions out-of-the-box.
strengths: Provides fine-grained, dynamic control over Android WindowManager flags per screen.
Automatically survives Activity recreation (such as rotation or locale changes).
Acts as an actively maintained successor to the unmaintained flutter_windowmanager.
weaknesses: Android-only; has no iOS support or plans for iOS.
Other flags beyond FLAG_SECURE have not been extensively tested.
data.setup_notes: No special permissions or setup steps are required beyond depending on the package.
